extracted.name: Homemade Horseradish Sauce
extracted.description: This quick and tasty homemade horseradish sauce is guaranteed to elevate your prime rib or roast beef to new levels. You can also try it with vegetables.
instruction_lines: Stir together sour cream, horseradish, chives, lemon juice, and cayenne pepper in a small bowl until well combined. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before serving.
